data.name: p281-research-r
data.yaml_source:
# #281 × #280: the Phase R research step (Lyness invariant) through the routing layer.
#
# Same deterministic spine as /research/stack/phase-r-smoke.yaml — normalize, manifest, two
# independent exact checkers, input-verify, Gate, preserve — unchanged. What changes is who runs
# the two model steps: the router picks a provider from quota; the routing/execution layer runs it
# (its own login, allowlist egress); the agent can write only through the Preloop MCP server.
# The model proposes and reviews; it never verifies (option A).
#
#   conductor run p281/workflows/research-r.yaml
workflow:
  name: p281-research-r
  description: Phase R (#280) with routed model steps; deterministic verification and Gate unchanged
  entry_point: route
  input:
    profile:
      type: string
      required: false
      default: research-default
      description: execution profile (config/profiles/<name>.yaml)
  limits:
    max_iterations: 24
    timeout_seconds: 2400

agents:
  - name: route
    type: script
    description: Collect quota observations and choose a provider (fail closed on HOLD)
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/route.py", "{{ workflow.input.profile }}"]
    output:
      decision: {type: string}
      provider: {type: string}
      reason: {type: string}
      evaluated: {type: string}
      model_route: {type: string}
      login: {type: string}
      profile: {type: string}
      evidence_dir: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: stage_in
        when: "{{ route.output.decision == 'ROUTE' }}"
      - to: record_hold

  - name: stage_in
    type: script
    description: Reference fixture into the agents' workspace
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/r_stage.py", "in"]
    routes:
      - to: propose

  # ---- model step 1: propose (routed) ----
  - name: propose
    type: script
    description: Routed model step — propose a candidate as term lists
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/agent_task.py", "{{ route.output.provider }}", "{{ route.output.model_route }}",
           "propose", "/work/p281/prompts/r-propose.md", "proposal.json",
           "{{ route.output.profile }}", "{{ route.output.login }}"]
    timeout: 700
    output: &agent_out
      status: {type: string}
      provider: {type: string}
      model_route: {type: string}
      run_id: {type: string}
      workspace: {type: string}
      produced_path: {type: string}
      produced: {type: boolean}
      model_session_reported: {type: string}
      model_adapter_reported: {type: string}
      model_served: {type: string}
      approvals_requested: {type: number}
      mcp_rule_denials: {type: number}
      retryable_elsewhere: {type: boolean}
      evidence_dir: {type: string}
      ledger_error: {type: string}
      profile: {type: string}
      measurements:
        type: object
        properties:
          total_tokens: {type: number, required: false}
          wall_ms: {type: number, required: false}
    routes:
      - to: normalize
        when: "{{ propose.output.produced }}"
      - to: propose_failed

  # ---- deterministic spine, identical to #280 Phase R ----
  - name: normalize
    type: script
    description: Validate the proposal as term lists and pin it into this run's directory
    command: /opt/venv/bin/python
    args: ["/research/stack/steps.py", "normalize", "{{ propose.output.produced_path }}"]
    routes:
      - to: reject_proposal
        when: "not ok"
      - to: manifest

  - name: manifest
    type: script
    description: Pin candidate, checker code and Gate rules by hash
    command: /opt/venv/bin/python
    args: ["/research/stack/steps.py", "manifest", "{{ normalize.output.candidate_path }}"]
    routes:
      - to: verify_primary

  - name: verify_primary
    type: script
    description: Exact identity check, SymPy engine
    command: /opt/venv/bin/python
    args: ["/research/stack/steps.py", "verify", "primary", "{{ normalize.output.candidate_path }}"]
    routes:
      - to: verify_independent

  - name: verify_independent
    type: script
    description: Exact identity check, no CAS
    command: /opt/venv/bin/python
    args: ["/research/stack/steps.py", "verify", "independent", "{{ normalize.output.candidate_path }}"]
    routes:
      - to: stage_review

  - name: stage_review
    type: script
    description: Candidate and both verifications into the agents' workspace, for the reviewer
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/r_stage.py", "review"]
    routes:
      - to: review

  # ---- model step 2: review (same routed provider) ----
  - name: review
    type: script
    description: Routed model step — review opinion, not evidence
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/agent_task.py", "{{ route.output.provider }}", "{{ route.output.model_route }}",
           "review", "/work/p281/prompts/r-review.md", "review.json",
           "{{ route.output.profile }}", "{{ route.output.login }}"]
    timeout: 700
    output: *agent_out
    routes:
      - to: stage_back

  - name: stage_back
    type: script
    description: review.json into the run directory; input-verify re-hashes and binds it
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/r_stage.py", "back"]
    routes:
      - to: input_verify

  - name: input_verify
    type: script
    description: Read every required artifact back, hash it, and freeze the Gate bundle
    command: /opt/venv/bin/python
    args: ["/research/stack/steps.py", "input-verify"]
    routes:
      - to: gate

  - name: gate
    type: script
    description: Pure function, frozen bundle in, decision out
    command: /opt/venv/bin/python
    args: ["/research/stack/gate.py"]
    stdin: "{{ input_verify.output.bundle | tojson }}"
    output:
      decision: {type: string}
      reason: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: preserve

  - name: preserve
    type: script
    description: Copy the run's event log next to its artifacts, on every decision path
    command: /opt/venv/bin/python
    args: ["/research/stack/steps.py", "preserve"]
    routes:
      - to: record

  - name: record
    type: script
    description: Record the routed research run in MLflow (a record failure never changes the outcome)
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/record.py"]
    stdin: "{{ {'execute': propose.output, 'check': {'decision': gate.output.decision, 'reason': gate.output.reason, 'file_sha256': normalize.output.candidate_sha256}, 'route': route.output} | tojson }}"
    output:
      mlflow_run_id: {type: string}
      experiment_id: {type: string}
      record_error: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: admitted
        when: "{{ gate.output.decision == 'ADMIT' }}"
      - to: refuted
        when: "{{ gate.output.decision == 'REFUTE' }}"
      - to: blocked
        when: "{{ gate.output.decision == 'BLOCK' }}"
      - to: gate_held

  - name: record_hold
    type: script
    description: Record the HOLD decision in MLflow — not starting is a result too
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/p281/steps/record.py"]
    stdin: "{{ {'route': route.output} | tojson }}"
    output:
      mlflow_run_id: {type: string}
      experiment_id: {type: string}
      record_error: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: held

  - name: admitted
    type: terminate
    status: success
    reason: "ADMIT: {{ gate.output.reason }}"

  - name: refuted
    type: terminate
    status: success
    reason: "REFUTE (a valid research outcome): {{ gate.output.reason }}"

  - name: blocked
    type: terminate
    status: failed
    reason: "BLOCK: {{ gate.output.reason }}"

  - name: gate_held
    type: terminate
    status: failed
    reason: "Gate HOLD: {{ gate.output.reason }}"

  - name: held
    type: terminate
    status: failed
    reason: "Router HOLD: {{ route.output.reason }}"

  - name: propose_failed
    type: terminate
    status: failed
    reason: "propose produced no proposal: {{ propose.output.status }}"

  - name: reject_proposal
    type: terminate
    status: failed
    reason: "proposal rejected before verification: {{ normalize.output.reason }}"

output:
  profile: "{{ route.output.profile }}"
  route: "{{ route.output.decision }}: {{ route.output.reason }}"
  provider: "{% if propose is defined %}{{ propose.output.provider }}{% endif %}"
  model_route: "{% if propose is defined %}{{ propose.output.model_route }}{% endif %}"
  decision: "{% if gate is defined %}{{ gate.output.decision }}{% endif %}"
  reason: "{% if gate is defined %}{{ gate.output.reason }}{% endif %}"
  candidate_sha256: "{% if normalize is defined %}{{ normalize.output.candidate_sha256 }}{% endif %}"
  primary_status: "{% if verify_primary is defined %}{{ verify_primary.output.math_status }}{% endif %}"
  independent_status: "{% if verify_independent is defined %}{{ verify_independent.output.math_status }}{% endif %}"
  review_status: "{% if review is defined %}{{ review.output.status }}{% endif %}"
  mlflow_run_id: "{% if record is defined %}{{ record.output.mlflow_run_id }}{% elif record_hold is defined %}{{ record_hold.output.mlflow_run_id }}{% endif %}"
  record_error: "{% if record is defined %}{{ record.output.record_error }}{% elif record_hold is defined %}{{ record_hold.output.record_error }}{% endif %}"
